note: The half that sailed from Port Hueneme on 6 Oct 1942 (the rolls' "Sec 2"); reunited with the second wave at Nouméa on 13 Dec 1942 (ncbhist-020/p2).
The half that stayed at Port Hueneme until 26 Nov 1942 (the rolls' "Section 1") (ncbhist-020/p2).
About 500 men: Townsville, Woodlark, Kiriwina, Milne Bay, Brisbane; the 1st Section from October 1943 (ncbhist-020/p2-p3).
The rest: Guadalcanal, the Russells, New Georgia, then Banika; the 2nd Section, its rolls headed "Detachment" and "Second Section" (ncbhist-020/p2-p3).

About 400 men (1 1/2 companies) under Lt. Riordan at Oloana Bay, Vangunu (ncbhist-020/p2; mcsol ch. 2). When it left isn't given; ended here when the section's units moved to Bau, Ondonga and Doke Doke.
About 140 men (one company) under Lt. Sanders at Viru Harbor (ncbhist-020/p2); a detachment left for Bau on or before 1 Oct 1943 (ncbhist-020/p3).
The PT-boat base on Bau Island, Rendova Harbor: 114 men in October, 195 by January (ncbhist-020/p3); to the Russells in January 1944.
